access-control/rbac-staff.rbac.spec.ts::: Authenticate as the seeded non-admin staff user (staff.deterministic@test.com, role "staff").
Call roles/create via the staff API session.
Assert the server rejects it with 403 FORBIDDEN — the staff role lacks role_management:create.
As the staff session, call invitations/create.
Assert the server rejects it with 403 FORBIDDEN — staff lacks user_management:create.
Verifies the permission guard at the server boundary, not just the UI.
Load /dashboard/access-control/roles in the staff browser session.
Assert the page renders without crashing.
Assert there is NO New/Create/Add role button — the UI hides what the server also blocks (defence-in-depth).
